summary.headline: Lots and Planetary Years
summary.text: Astrological judgments from the marriage, siblings, fortune, father, and mother lots, including planetary rulerships, signs, aspects, and indications of parent or sibling loss. Section 49 then tabulates the perfect and least years and twelfth-part years or months of the Sun, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury.
